speaker: bartholomew_hathaway
text: Stop. This is the hour. Bread, and sit off the stubble.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: An hour. Then the same row, if it is still the row.

speaker: bartholomew_hathaway
text: It will be the same field. The ears will not have grown while you chew.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I can see that from the bond. I am not here to improve it.

speaker: bartholomew_hathaway
text: Good. Eat the bread your wife sent. The field has no second dinner.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then one hour, and I am up when you are up.
